meta.name: agentkit-multimedia-shopping
meta.description: 基于ByteDance agentkit-samples多媒体用例的小省导购员数字人带货视频生成技能，整合多模态内容生成能力（图像、视频、音频），支持AI绘画、语音合成、视频生成，与小省导购员人设融合，9:16竖屏适配，直接对接带货视频生成流程

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成带货视频，融合图像、语音和动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速生成带货视频并整合多模态内容
copy.tagline_en: Generate shopping videos with images, voice, and animation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create product promotion videos with multimodal content

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会用AI绘画生成导购员角色形象和场景背景，用语音合成生成导购员语音和背景音乐，再组合生成9:16竖屏的25秒带货视频。
howto.when: 当你提出生成小省导购员数字人带货视频，或需要角色形象、语音、背景音乐等素材时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成小省导购员在商务会议室的25秒带货视频。
say.note: 会按图像→音频→视频顺序生成完整成片。

say.text: 只生成小省导购员的角色参考图，9:16竖屏。
say.note: 会调用角色生成脚本产出参考图。

say.text: 给小省导购员的带货文案合成语音，配一段热情的背景音乐。
say.note: 会合成16kHz单声道wav音频文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use AI painting to create the shopping guide's character image and scene background, use TTS to generate the guide's voice and background music, then combine them into a 25-second 9:16 vertical product-promotion video.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to generate a Xiaosheng shopping-guide digital human product video, or request character images, voice, background music, and other multimedia assets.

say_en.text: Generate a 25-second product video of the Xiaosheng shopping guide in a business meeting room.
say_en.note: It will produce a full video following image→audio→video.

say_en.text: Only generate the shopping guide's character reference image, 9:16 vertical.
say_en.note: It will call the character generation script.

say_en.text: Synthesize voice for the guide's copy and add an enthusiastic background music.
say_en.note: It will export 16kHz mono wav audio files.
